subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Quality Assurance Defined
description: A fast breakdown of Quality Assurance Defined for builders.

hook.text: A bank app crashes during payroll. Millions are delayed. One missing test could have caught it.

buildup.text: Quality assurance is the process of preventing defects in products before they reach users.

discovery.text: It spans the entire lifecycle—requirements, design, code, testing, and release—not just the end.

twist.text: QA isn't just testing. Testing finds bugs. QA builds the system that prevents them from existing.

climax.text: Companies with strong QA ship faster because they spend less time fighting fires after release.

punchline.text: QA prevents problems. Testing discovers them.

quiz.question: What is the primary goal of quality assurance?
options: Preventing defects before they reach users
